note: Regression: the thin variable's addition copies its own list's coding (`copy_coding`), and the register file also has a `[[representation.parallel]]` entry. Compiling that entry replays the register's occurrence cases without bound donor coding, so the build used to abort with the bare `ValueError` "copied coding requires original donor binding evidence" (pipeline_build_failed). The entry names a COL2 the source never delivers, so it goes stale; COL keeps the sibling case's state and its two members.
fails_if: an occurrence-case replay again requires bound donor coding for a copied-coding addition (`apply_occurrence_cases` in source_effects.py), so compiling the parallel entry aborts the build instead of reporting it stale

sources.description: Authored canonical-SCB register r (open from 2010) whose variable COL names its own list own-list.csv (01 First, 02 Second), as in thin-variable-carries-the-members-of-its-own-declared-list. Plus the SCB sample.

files.scb_canonical/scb_canonical.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "R"
valid_from = "2010-01-01"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Col"
column = "COL"
data_type = "text"
value_set = "own-list"
